ASBU, established in 2013 and located in Ankara, is
the first and only state university in Türkiye
specialising in social sciences.
As a state university, ASBU:
Focuses on research-oriented education
Values international cooperation
 Prioritises research on contemporary issues
 Maintains a global perspective
 Boasts a rich library that offers multilingual
and multicultural resources
Integrates national and spiritual values into
society, positively impacting the community
Contributes to the transformation of its
surrounding environment

SCHOOL FACILITIES
Transportation Facilities 
Since the campus is located in the centre of
Ankara, our campus is easily accessible via various
public transport options, including buses and metro
lines, ensuring a smooth commute for students and
staff.
For the arrival station, you may use
https://www.asti.com.tr/
https://esenbogaairport.com/tr-
TR/havalimanina-ulasim/page/havas-otobusleri
https://www.tcdd.gov.tr/ankara-yht-gari
https://www.ego.gov.tr/tr
Medical Services
Our health centre provides primary medical care,
first aid, and consultations with healthcare
professionals during working hours. The
university’s medical centre operates on a by-
appointment basis. Appointments can be
scheduled through the online system.
https://sksdb.asbu.edu.tr/tr/saglik-hizmetleri-1

SCHOOL FACILITIES
Accomodation
Our university does not provide accommodation
services, and we are unable to assist with housing
arrangements. However, students can find various
dormitory and rental options in Ankara on their
own.
Student Societies
Our student clubs cover a wide range of interests,
including literature, technology, music,
international relations, and more. Whatever your
passion may be, there is a place for you!
https://topluluk.asbu.edu.tr/
Campus Details
A comprehensive map of our campus is available
on the next page for your convenience.

Student societies at our university aim to ensure that all our
students engage in productive activities outside of their academic
studies. These societies organize a variety of professional,
scientific, social, artistic, cultural, and sports events. Our goal is not
only to help students gain academic skills but also to foster
teamwork and representation skills, preparing them for life with
increased self-confidence. These societies serve as a gathering
place for students with shared interests and are a platform for
forming new friendships through creative projects.

EXPERIENCESEXPERIENCES

The Self-Access Centre (SAC) at the
School of Foreign Languages offers a
vibrant and stress-free environment for
students to practice their English skills.
Students can engage with various
materials and activities either
independently or with guidance from a
teacher. The SAC provides an immersive
experience primarily in English while also
integrating Arabic in various ways.
The main goal of the SAC is to enhance
English language learning beyond the
confines of the raditional classroom
setting.
SAC at ASBU assists students in developing independent learning skills
and proficiency in four language skills: reading, writing, listening, and
speaking. To help students acquire these independent learning skills,
the SAC offers regular workshops focused on self-study techniques and
provides information about useful websites and online applications.
SACSAC

School of Foreign Languages at ASBU   was deemed worthy of the "Orange Flag"
award within the scope of the Barrier-Free University 2024 awards given by the
Council of Higher Education in order to raise awareness and disseminate good
practices regarding the access of disabled individuals to venues, educational
opportunities and socio-cultural activities at universities.
